notes: §2002:11.6.2 SR3 requires that an OVERRIDE name a superclass method with the same NAME that is not FINAL. A same-interface override and a covariant-RETURNING override (§2002:9.3.7.1.2 rule 5c2) are both accepted and dispatch to the overriding method per §2002:11.6.3 GR2 ('I AM Y', 'I AM X'). An OVERRIDE with no such method is refused with COBOL0838, and an OVERRIDE of a FINAL method with COBOL0839. Matched at --std 2002 on build dc1f2dcce8.
